variants.name: Category navigation
findings: Overflowing labels are cut mid-word with no edge cue (300px fixture 'Productio', Scrolled 'roduction').

findings.text: When tabs overflow, a label is hard-cut mid-word with no cue that the strip scrolls (300px and Scrolled cells; in the 323px atlas cells even the 3-category Default cuts 'Productic'). Real phones at 360px+ fit three English labels, so this only bites on stress cases.
findings.fix: Add scroll-snap-type:x proximity with scroll-snap-align:start on tabs and a token-based edge fade (mask-image) on .st-category-tabs when scrollWidth > clientWidth.
